documents.name: Age proof (Matriculation or equivalent certificate)
documents.quote: One self-attested copy of the Matriculation or equivalent certificate or other admissible evidence of age.

documents.name: Education qualification copies
documents.quote: One self-attested copy of Education Qualifications (Degrees, Diplomas etc.), experiences etc.

documents.name: Guru/Institute training certificate (Part II of proforma)
documents.quote: The Certificate to this effect in Part II of the Proforma duly signed by the present Guru / Institute

name: Scheme for Scholarships to Young Artistes in Different Cultural Fields
provider: Ministry of Culture, Government of India (administered with CCRT)

rules.quote: The candidate's age should not be less than 18 years and not more than 25 years as on 1st April of the year in which the application is being made.
Indian Classical Music, Indian Classical Dance, Theatre, Mime, Visual art, Folk, Traditional and Indigenous Arts and Light Classical Music.

rules.value: minimum 5 years of training under a Guru/institute
rules.quote: The candidate should have undergone a minimum of 5 years training with their Guru/Institutes.

rules.value: visual arts applicants: minimum qualification BFA or equivalent
rules.quote: The minimum qualification for Visual Arts is BFA or equivalent.

rules.value: selection by interview/performance before expert committee, purely on merit
rules.quote: The selection will be made purely on merit.

amount.text: Rs 5,000 per month for two years; 400 scholarships in total
amount.quote: Each scholar will be paid Rs. 5000/- per month for a period of two years

deadline.text: No date on page; advertisement is issued each year by CCRT
deadline.quote: An advertisement inviting applications will be issued by Centre for Cultural Resources and Training (CCRT), 15-A, Sector-7, Dwarka, New Delhi-110075.
